narrative_vs_numbers.management_says: Management consistently guides for robust revenue growth of 15% for FY26 and 10% to 12% for FY27.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers_say: Quarterly sales show continuous expansion from 61,555 INR crore in Sep 2024 to 82,762 INR crore by Mar 2026.

narrative_vs_numbers.management_says: Management targets stable margins and an 8.5% benchmark for P&M.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers_say: OPM percentages remained steady around 12% to 13% across multiple quarters.

promises.credibility: Management demonstrates solid credibility with historical revenue and margin targets largely met or progressing as stated.

bull: Revenue grew +16% YoY in the latest quarter Sep 2026, matching a steady 3y and 5y revenue CAGR of ~16%.
The 5-yr cumulative CFO is 1.15x PAT with ₹86,099 Cr vs ₹75,124 Cr, and positive free cash flow of ₹67,047 Cr.
Debt to equity improved to 1.24 from 1.35 three periods ago, showing stronger financial leverage.
bear: Operating margins are compressing, with the latest quarter margin at 11.2% (-1.3pp YoY) and OPM at 13% versus a 15% historical average.
Return on equity stands at 15.9%, which is slightly below the long-term target of 16% to 17%.
Management guidance for order inflows and revenue growth remains pending as the FY27 horizon has not yet ended.
bull_bear.what_would_change_my_mind: Clear evidence of margin recovery above 13% or definitive achievement of FY27 revenue guidance.
